name: Shelley Moore Capito
stance: Champion of independent third-party AI auditing and verification — co-author of the VET AI Act directing NIST to set guidelines for external assurance of AI companies' safety and risk-management claims.

statements.text: Introduced the bipartisan VET AI Act with Sen. Hickenlooper, directing NIST to develop specifications and guidelines for third-party evaluators to provide independent external assurance and verification of how AI systems are developed and tested.
Reintroduced the VET AI Act with Sen. Hickenlooper in the 119th Congress.
